title: Belief in Allah’s books and scrolls
intro: “Wa kutubihi” – I believe in Allah’s books, through which He guides people to the good.

learn.text: O you who have believed, believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Book that He sent down upon His Messenger and the Scripture which He sent down before. And whoever disbelieves in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day has certainly gone far astray.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Every Muslim, man and woman, must believe in the pillars of Iman.

Allah’s books contain Allah’s speech, revealed through the angel Jibril to Allah’s messengers, so that they pass it on and explain it to people. They contain guidance, advice, rules for people’s life and work, and truths people could never find out any other way. By revealing the books, Allah (SWT) turned the human mind towards good and right action.

The first revelation was given to the first man and messenger, Adam (AS). This means that from the very beginning of life on Earth people had Allah’s guidance. According to Islamic tradition, 100 scrolls (suhuf – smaller revelations) and four great books were revealed:

learn.title: 📜 The Tawrah (Torah) – revealed to Musa (AS)
learn.html: The first great book. The original Tawrah no longer exists, because people changed it.

learn.text: Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which was guidance and light.

learn.title: 📜 The Zabur – revealed to Dawud (AS)
learn.html: The Zabur has not been kept in its original form either. Today’s version is called the Psalms, which in Hebrew means “religious songs”.

learn.text: and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].

learn.title: 📜 The Injil – revealed to ‘Isa (AS)
learn.html: The Qur’an speaks a lot about the Injil. It confirmed the books revealed before it and announced the coming of Muhammad (SAW). The changed version of the Injil is called the Gospel; the church accepts four versions: Matthew, Luke, Mark and John.

learn.text: and We gave him the Gospel, in which was guidance and light and confirming that which preceded it of the Torah

learn.title: 📖 The Qur’an – revealed to Muhammad (SAW)
learn.html: Allah’s last revelation, revealed to Allah’s last messenger, to guide all people until the Day of Judgement.

learn.alt: A boy in a white cap reading the Qur’an on a stand

learn.html: In the Qur’an, Allah (SWT) mentions the scrolls of Ibrahim (AS) and Musa (AS):

learn.text: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself And mentions the name of his Lord and prays. But you prefer the worldly life, While the Hereafter is better and more enduring. Indeed, this is in the former scriptures, The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

learn.html: Ibn Hibban reports in his Sahih: “He revealed fifty scrolls to Shith, thirty to Idris, ten to Ibrahim, and ten to Musa before the Tawrah.” So the scrolls were revealed to these messengers:

By sending revelation, Allah (SWT) gave people great mercy, guidance and support. With the revelation a person finds the right path in this life, keeps away from great sins, and reaches salvation and reward – Jannah – in the akhirah.

practice.title: Match the book and the messenger

questions.q: Allah’s books contain guidance, advice, rules for life and…
options: truths people could not find out any other way

questions.q: The first revelation was given to…
options: Adam (AS), the first man and messenger

questions.q: In total, the revelation came as…
Through which angel were Allah’s books revealed?
Which was the first great book?
What is today’s version of the Zabur called?
Which book announced the coming of Muhammad (SAW)?
Which revelation is for all people until the Day of Judgement?

practice.title: Choose a task
prompts: 🔎 Which of Allah’s revelations has been used the longest in human history, and what is most special about it today?
🤔 Each people had to follow the messenger sent to them with a revelation. Which revelation did messengers like Salih (AS) and Ishaq (AS), who did not receive a book, follow?
👳 Talk with your mu‘allim: the Qur’an is Allah’s revelation for all people.
